Add --kv-hicache-ratio and --mamba-hicache-ratio so KV and Mamba L2
  pools can be sized independently.

  ## Motivation

  Hybrid KV/Mamba workloads may need different L2 host pool sizing for KV
  cache and Mamba state cache. A single `--hicache-ratio` forces both
  pools to use the same ratio, which makes it harder to tune host memory
  usage for mixed cache layouts.

  ## Modifications

  - Add `--kv-hicache-ratio` and `--mamba-hicache-ratio`.
  - Default both new ratios to `--hicache-ratio` when unset, preserving
  existing behavior.
  - Route KV host pool sizing through the resolved KV ratio.
  - Route Mamba host pool sizing through the resolved Mamba ratio.
  - Apply the KV ratio to decode-side offload host pool sizing.
  - Add server args unit coverage for defaulting, override, validation,
  and `--hicache-size` warning behavior.
  - Update HiCache and server argument documentation.

  ## Accuracy Tests

  Not applicable. This PR only changes HiCache host pool sizing
  configuration and does not modify model forward logic or kernel outputs.

  Local checks:
  - `python -m py_compile ...` passed.
  - `PYTHONPATH=python pytest -q test/registered/unit/server_args/
  test_server_args.py -k HiCacheArgs` could not run in the current local
  environment because `triton` is not installed.

  ## Speed Tests and Profiling

  Not applicable. This PR does not claim a speed improvement; it adds
  tuning knobs for L2 host pool sizing.

  ## Checklist

  - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit]
  (https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-
  code-with-pre-commit).
  - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://
  docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-
  tests).
  - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://
  docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-
  documentations).
  - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test
  the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/
  contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed]
  (https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/
  contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
  - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/
  developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

  ## Review and Merge Process

  1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process]
  (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/
  MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
  2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/
  sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
  3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/
  developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or
  contact authorized users to do so.
     - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`,
     `/rerun-failed-ci`
  4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people
  with Write permission to merge the PR.

 --page-size 64                        # Page size for cache management

---hicache-size 100                    # Host memory size in GBs, will override the above ratio

+--mamba-hicache-ratio 1.5             # Optional Mamba L2 ratio, defaults to --hicache-ratio

 --hicache-storage-backend             # Optional storage backend (e.g., hf3fs, mooncake, etc.)

@@ -134,7 +134,9 @@ Specifically, **LMCache**, an efficient KV cache layer for enterprise-scale LLM
 
 - **`--hicache-ratio HICACHE_RATIO`**: The ratio of the size of host KV cache memory pool to the size of device pool. For example, a value of 2 means the host memory pool is twice as large as the device memory pool. The value of this parameter must be greater than 1, as the current implementation requires the host memory allocated for the KV cache to be larger than the device memory allocated for the KV cache.
 
-- **`--hicache-size HICACHE_SIZE`**: The size of host KV cache memory pool in gigabytes. This parameter overrides `hicache-ratio` if set. For example, `--hicache-size 30` allocates 30GB (1GB = 1e9 bytes) for the host memory pool **for each rank**. If there are 8 ranks, then the total memory size is 240GB. Just like `hicache-ratio`, the value of this parameter must be larger than the size of device memory allocated for KV cache.
+- **`--kv-hicache-ratio KV_HICACHE_RATIO`** and **`--mamba-hicache-ratio MAMBA_HICACHE_RATIO`**: Optional per-pool ratios for hybrid cache configurations. They default to `--hicache-ratio` when unset, allowing KV and Mamba L2 host pools to be sized independently.
+
+- **`--hicache-size HICACHE_SIZE`**: The size of host KV cache memory pool in gigabytes. This parameter overrides ratio-based host pool sizing if set, including `hicache-ratio`, `kv-hicache-ratio`, and `mamba-hicache-ratio`. For example, `--hicache-size 30` allocates 30GB (1GB = 1e9 bytes) for the host memory pool **for each rank**. If there are 8 ranks, then the total memory size is 240GB. Just like `hicache-ratio`, the value of this parameter must be larger than the size of device memory allocated for KV cache.
 
 **Note**: `--hicache-ratio` and `--hicache-size` are two critical parameters. In general, a larger HiCache size leads to a higher cache hit rate, which improves prefill performance. However, the relationship between cache size and hit rate is not linear. Once most reusable KV data—especially hot tokens—are already cached, further increasing the size may yield only marginal performance gains. Users can set these parameters based on their workload characteristics and performance requirements.
